description: This file defines configuration-related classes for a plugin system within the WPEFramework. It includes classes for managing JSON-based configuration data, such as 'Config' and 'RootConfig', as well as a 'Setting' class for logging configuration settings. The file also references external modules and interfaces related to plugin configuration, system paths, and JSON handling.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Main configuration class for the plugin, encapsulating various configuration parameters and nested classes for detailed settings.

classes.name: Config::RootConfig
classes.description: Nested class representing the root configuration parameters, including system locator, user, mode, and remote address.

classes.name: Config::RootObject
classes.description: Helper class for JSON parsing of the 'root' configuration object.

classes.name: Config::Setting
classes.description: Utility class for logging and representing individual configuration settings.

methods.name: Config::DataPath
methods.description: Constructs a data path string based on the base path and class name.

methods.name: Config::PersistentPath
methods.description: Constructs a persistent storage path based on the base path and postfix or callsign.

methods.name: Config::VolatilePath
methods.description: Constructs a volatile storage path based on the base path and postfix or callsign.

methods.name: Config::IsSameInstance
methods.description: Checks if another Config instance refers to the same system instance based on locator and class name.

methods.name: Config::Setting::Setting
methods.description: Constructor for boolean and string settings, logs the setting.
